questions.question: To conduct Sports Day activities, lines have been drawn with chalk powder at a distance of 1 m each, in a rectangular ground. 100 flower pots are placed at a distance of 1 m from each other along each line. answer_steps: Taking the starting corner as the origin, the green flag is at $(2, 25)$ and the red flag at $(8, 20)$.

questions.question: The vertices of $\triangle ABC$ are $A(4, 6)$, $B(1, 5)$ and $C(7, 2)$. A line is drawn to intersect sides $AB$ and $AC$ at $D$ and $E$ respectively, such that $\dfrac{AD}{AB} = \dfrac{AE}{AC} = \dfrac{1}{4}$. Find the coordinates of $D$ and $E$, and show that $DE = \dfrac{1}{4}BC$.
questions.question_hi: $\triangle ABC$ के शीर्ष $A(4, 6)$, $B(1, 5)$ और $C(7, 2)$ हैं। भुजाओं $AB$ और $AC$ को क्रमशः $D$ और $E$ पर प्रतिच्छेद करती एक रेखा इस प्रकार खींची गई है कि $\dfrac{AD}{AB} = \dfrac{AE}{AC} = \dfrac{1}{4}$ है। $D$ और $E$ के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए और दर्शाइए कि $DE = \dfrac{1}{4}BC$ है।
questions.question_gu: $\triangle ABC$ નાં શિરોબિંદુઓ $A(4, 6)$, $B(1, 5)$ અને $C(7, 2)$ છે. બાજુઓ $AB$ અને $AC$ ને અનુક્રમે $D$ અને $E$ માં છેદતી રેખા એવી રીતે દોરી છે કે $\dfrac{AD}{AB} = \dfrac{AE}{AC} = \dfrac{1}{4}$. $D$ અને $E$ ના યામ શોધો અને બતાવો કે $DE = \dfrac{1}{4}BC$.
